hook: Venkatesan has spent 25 years running the technology behind some of the largest consumer platforms in commerce and advertising, eBay, StubHub, Marketo, Yahoo, Walmart, and now PayPal, where he leads AI and machine learning across the company's entire payments ecosystem.
name: Srini Venkatesan

quote.text: Over the past 25 years, Srini has played a pivotal role in building and scaling technology organizations. From early-stage startups to Fortune 1 enterprises, his technology and product leadership has been fundamental to their growth and success.
quote.context: Srini Venkatesan, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: EVP and Chief Technology Officer at PayPal

timeline.event: Begins engineering career at Actel Corporation

timeline.impact: Begins eight years leading eBay's trading platform
Leads technology through five years of growth
Leads the company through its IPO

timeline.event: Joins Yahoo to lead Ads and Data engineering
timeline.impact: Scales ad technology to $3 billion in revenue
Leads supply chain and later omnichannel platform technology

timeline.event: Named EVP and CTO of PayPal
timeline.impact: Leads AI and technology across the PayPal ecosystem

quick_facts: EVP and CTO of PayPal, leading technology across analytics, AI/ML, infrastructure, security, and product engineering
Previously EVP of U.S. Omni Tech at Walmart, leading Walmart+ and omnichannel platform technology
Led Yahoo's Display and Video Ad technology, contributing to $3 billion in ad revenue
Took Marketo public as CTO, then led engineering at StubHub and eBay across a 25-year career

achievements.title: EVP and CTO, PayPal (2024-present)
achievements.impact: Leads technology across analytics and data science, AI and machine learning, infrastructure, security, and product engineering for the entire PayPal ecosystem.

achievements.title: EVP, U.S. Omni & Platforms Technology, Walmart Global Tech (2020-2024)
achievements.impact: Led Walmart+ member experience and omnichannel platform technology, including the global marketplace and omni supply chain.

achievements.title: VP of Engineering, Ads and Data, Yahoo
achievements.impact: Oversaw Display and Video Ad technology contributing $3 billion in ad revenue, and led the integration of Flurry and BrightRoll acquisitions.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, Marketo
achievements.impact: Ran product strategy and technology through Marketo's IPO, scaling the core product to 80% year-over-year enterprise sales growth while improving gross margins.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, StubHub (2007-2012)
achievements.impact: Built industry-leading electronic ticket delivery and seat-map visualization technology.
